claim: ARD conducts recursive analysis to pursue research questions autonomously.
ARD enables AI to autonomously improve itself through recursive system analysis, continuous research integration, dream generation, safe testing, and audited selection.

ARD provides three core guarantees: recursive self-improvement (systematic examination of all system layers), research-grounded dreams (continuous research integration from external sources), and safe testing & meta-improvement (all dreams tested in isolated environments).

ARD integrates with VIF for confidence tracking, CAS for cognitive analysis, IIS for intuitive evaluation, CMC for persistent storage, HHNI for context retrieval, SEG for knowledge synthesis, and APOE for orchestration.
ARD's Recursive System Analyzer (RSA) performs hierarchical system examination analyzing all layers from main systems through sub-systems, implementations, documentation, and meta-processes.
ARD's Continuous Research Engine (CRE) extracts concepts from systems, builds dynamic search tags, researches external sources (arxiv, GitHub, publications), and ranks by relevance.
ARD's Safe Dream Testing (SDT) tests dream scenarios in isolated VM/sandbox environments, measures results, compares to baseline, and validates improvements before implementation.
ARD's Meta-R&D Self-Improvement (MRSI) analyzes R&D effectiveness, refines processes, and improves the R&D process itself, creating a self-improving meta-system.
